# Parse all notes into structured data
import re

all_data = []
for note in notes:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for 2023-05-17"
    title = note['title']
    date_match = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', title)
    if not date_match:
        print(f"Could not find date in title: {title}")
        continue
    date = date_match.group(1)
    
    # Parse content lines
    content = note['content']
    values = {}
    for line in content.strip().split('\n'):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        if ':' in line:
            habit, val = line.split(':', 1)
            values[habit.strip()] = val.strip()
    
    all_data.append({'date': date, 'values': values})

print(f"Parsed {len(all_data)} notes")
print("First entry:", all_data[0])
print("Last entry:", all_data[-1])
